Welcome to GitHub Markdown Reader v1.0.3

Action Required: Enable Local File Access

Chrome requires one manual permission toggle before extensions can read local file:/// files.

1

Open Extension Settings

Click the button below to open Chrome's settings for this extension:

2

Turn ON "Allow access to file URLs"

Scroll down on the settings tab and switch the toggle to ON:

Allow access to file URLs (must be enabled)
3

You're Ready!

Drag and drop any .md file into Chrome or press Ctrl + O to open a file. It will automatically render with authentic GitHub styles, alerts, math, outline, and code highlighting!

Quick Shortcuts

  • Alt + M: Toggle between rendered GitHub Markdown and raw text.
  • Outline button: View the collapsible table of contents with scrollspy.
  • Theme button: Switch between System, Light, and Dark mode anytime.
